summary: Verified (1) Web + Mobile dashboard budget-box rename to Starting / Used / Available Budget and (2) mobile toast sweep. Web dashboard renders 3 GlanceTile boxes (glance-starting $6,868.83, glance-spent $4,564.59, glance-spare $2,304.24) with the new STARTING BUDGET / USED BUDGET / AVAILABLE BUDGET labels. Mobile dashboard renders the same three testIDs with identical labels and values — no crash, GlanceBox is defined at module scope. Mobile toast system confirmed end-to-end via Correspondence add + delete (both success toasts appeared top-of-screen). All 20 regression routes (care-plans, complaints, cases, correspondence, documents, family-members, letters, athm, chsp-tools, handover-pack, hospital, referrals, profile-edit, budget-scenarios, scenarios, provider-switch, pacing, price-history, contribution-position, reports) loaded without a red-box or 'is not defined' error. Backend skipped per request.

ui_bugs.issue: On 390px viewport the Starting Budget value is ellipsized to '$6,868....' because 17px heading + 10px horizontal padding is too wide for a 5-digit AUD figure in a third-width box. Label 'STARTING BUDGET' also wraps to two lines. adjustsFontSizeToFit is set but minimumFontScale=0.6 leaves it just above fit. Consider dropping label to 8px / letterSpacing, value to 15-16px, or using moneyWhole() for the three tiles.

issues: Starting Budget value truncated on small widths (see ui_bug above); other two tiles ($4,564.59 and $2,304.24) fit fine.

action_items: (LOW) Tighten mobile dashboard GlanceBox typography so 5-digit AUD values (e.g. $6,868.83) don't ellipsize on 390px width — e.g. value fontSize 15-16 or use moneyWhole() for the three tiles.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (dashboard rename + toast sweep + 20-route regression all pass)
